text: Jordan Vance walks Priya Desai's and Omar Haddad's teams through what a real question and answer actually looks like inside the Wrenfield knowledge assistant.
An employee asks in plain language -- how many PTO days carry over, how to request VPN access -- and gets an answer with a citation back to the real HR, IT, or Ops document.
When nothing in hr-policies, it-wiki, or ops-sops actually supports an answer, it says so honestly instead of guessing.
The honest boundary: the assistant answers questions. It does not submit a hardware ticket or change a benefits election on anyone's behalf -- that's still a human's job.
A real next step, not built yet, is an agent that could take that kind of action -- consistent with this platform's own agentic-AI course, but not part of what shipped here.
